messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — QuantumLedger renewal is in a legal loop. Procurement just sent a revised PO that switches payment to net-60 and adds a data residency line. They want signatures this week, but legal flagged section 7.2. Can we triage?

tom_ae: Chatted w/ Simon at QuantumLedger a few mins ago. They said their procurement ops default to net-60. They did sign the SOW but sent redlines on the T&Cs. Do we have flexibility on net terms?

maya_cs: They signed the commercial terms but legal is worried about data retention + a requested attestation clause. If we can't move quick they may delay signing until next month.

anya_legal: Saw the redline. Two asks: extend retention from 30 -> 90 days, and an added SOC/attestation sentence. We can accept 90 days. The attestation clause as written is too broad. Propose compromise language below — please use when sending back: 
```
"Customer Data will be retained for a maximum of 90 days unless otherwise required by applicable law. Redwood Inference will maintain industry-standard security controls and will provide attestation of controls upon reasonable request and under NDA."
```

kevin_finance: Net-45 would be ideal for us. If they insist on net-60 we should request a 25% upfront deposit or set the contract start date to invoice payment date. Cashflow matters here.

tom_ae: Customer prefers no deposit. I can offer an early-pay discount (1% if paid in 15 days) as a compromise — ok to offer that with the legal compromise?

maya_cs: Yes, that might work. @anya_legal can you confirm the compromise language is ok to send? If legal signs off, I'll get the e-sign link out today. Need signature by Fri EOD to hit renewal target.

anya_legal: Confirmed. The snippet above is good. I'll fast-track a one-off redline and waive the attestation requirement being in the main body; keep attestation under NDA addendum. Send their redline back with our markup and the PO instructions.

billing-bot: Invoice draft created: INV-2026-QL-001 — amount matches committed $150k, terms: net-45 (draft). Link: https://billing.redwood/inv/INV-2026-QL-001

kevin_finance: Thanks @billing-bot. If they counter to net-60 we should: 1) set contract effective date to payment date, 2) mark renewal risk = medium in CRM, and 3) ask for PO referencing the invoice number.

tom_ae: Sending revised T&Cs + PO guidance to Simon now with early-pay 1% option. Will push procurement to accept the 90-day retention compromise and ask them to sign in DocuSign. I’ll ping here if they push the attestation clause again.

maya_cs: Great. I’ll watch and coordinate with enablement to schedule a short handover once signed. Goal: keep onboarding kickoff week of next month.

anya_legal: If they respond tonight, I'll do a final pass and upload countersign-ready doc.

tom_ae: :thumbsup: ping me for escalation to Sales Director if procurement reverts.

maya_cs: Thanks all — I’ll update thread as soon as I have countersign or a blocker. :eyes:
